title: Y2K was a memory-saving decision coming due
body: Saving two digits per date was rational when memory cost real money, so systems stored years as 68 or 99. By the late 1990s those systems ran banks and power grids, and '00' threatened to sort as 1900. A global remediation effort, not luck, made the rollover mostly uneventful.
source_hint: Y2K remediation records (US Senate / GAO reports)
